note: 22 Nov, the owner: "run the q4 for reap analysis too", then "top 90%, top 80%, top 75%, top 65% top 60%, top 50%, and gets tool scores for each level if possible". Step 1: REAP read of the Nov 21 Flash-Next tool runs the (fixed) scorers passed (trace-read --passed --mass), keep lists per job kind and for all jobs together (all-keep-NN.json) at 90/80/75/65/60/50%. Step 2: for 100% (all experts) and each level, the live expert mask (patch 0001, expert-mask.mjs) and Bob's HELD-OUT jobs (inbox, office, repo, web; never tuned on), each scored. Nothing is cut, healed or uploaded: the mask only routes among the kept experts, so each level shows what a cut would cost before any file is made. The owner's standing budget (the RunPod balance) covers it. 1 x H200 or H200 NVL (the account allows one at a time). Caps 5.5 h / $22.
